home.title: Funny Multi
home.subtitle: Build absurd stories together, 3 to 7 players. Phone-friendly.
home.rules: Each round, pick an answer to a playful question from the list. Your picks get mixed with everyone else's into absurd stories. Then each story becomes a cartoon and we reveal them all.
home.roomGone: That room no longer exists — it may have ended, or the link is old.
home.imagesToday: Up to {{total}} cartoons per day. Resets daily at 00:00 UTC.
home.uiLanguage: Tap to change the interface language
home.unsupportedLanguage: This room is in a language this app version cannot play yet. Try updating the page, or create a new room.
home.multiLanguageHint: Each player plays in the language picked with the flags above.
home.packCodeHint: Every room you create on this phone plays all the Christmas stories, until {{date}}.
home.packEnded: Your Christmas 2026 edition has ended. Thank you for playing!

lobby.christmasPaid: 🔔 Every story in this game is a Christmas story

support.title: Support
support.intro: This is a voluntary gift — nothing is owed and nothing unlocks.

pay.card: You just saw one Christmas story. Unlock all of them: {{price}}, every game, until {{date}}.
pay.pitch: All the Christmas stories, in every game, until {{date}}. One payment, no subscription.
pay.oncePayId: By PayID, from any Australian bank.
pay.onceSponsors: By card on GitHub Sponsors. Your bank converts it.
pay.guide1: Sign in to GitHub, or create a free account.
pay.guide3: Pay and come back here: your code appears.
pay.otherLanguages: The Christmas stories are not written in your language. The pack plays in rooms in these languages:
pay.refunds: No refunds for a change of mind. A pack that doesn't work is fixed or refunded.
pay.loginHint: The one you will pay with: that is how your payment finds your code.
pay.loginInvalid: That can’t be a GitHub user name. Check it: only Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.
pay.waitingGitHub: Waiting for GitHub to tell us you’ve paid…
pay.slowGitHub: Paid, and still nothing here after a few minutes? Your code waits on this phone: open this page again later. If GitHub doesn’t tell us, we check by hand within 2 days.
pay.failed: The payment can't be started right now. Please try again a little later.
pay.ended: The Christmas 2026 edition is no longer on sale.
pay.closed: The pack can't be bought right now. Please come back later.
pay.transferTitle: Pay from your bank’s app, to this PayID:
pay.referenceHint: Put the code in the payment’s reference or description, exactly as it is here: that is how your payment is matched to your code.
pay.paidWarning: Sent the money? Press “I’ve paid” before you close this page: your code starts working then. If you close it first, your code waits until we find your payment by hand.
pay.claimFailed: That didn’t go through. Check your connection and press again.
pay.leaveText: Press “I’ve paid” first, so your code works now. Not paid yet? Your code stays on this phone: open this page again when you have.
pay.paidTitle: Thank you! Your code works now.
pay.paidCheck: We check by hand that your payment has arrived. If it hasn’t within 2 days, the code stops working.

footer.paid: Your Christmas 2026 stories: every game, enjoy your party :))
footer.contentNotice: Player picks and AI pictures are the responsibility of the operator of this server, not of the upstream project.

errors.CODE_INVALID: That Christmas code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.CODE_BLOCKED: This Christmas code no longer works.
errors.CODE_PENDING: This Christmas code is waiting for its payment.
